format: English (NA/EU/OC/LATAM/ME) Standard Regulation, Blocks 2-5 legal (Apr 1 2026 - Mar 31 2027); newest legal booster OP17 (released 2026-08-28); banned/restricted list effective 2026-10-12 (OP14-020 banned)
countingMethod: Sum of final placings 1-8 per leader card ID across 33 Limitless-platform online Standard events (24+ players, decklists published) in the window, after excluding Extra Regulation events, events whose decklists use cards not yet released in English (EB05 before 2026-10-30, OP17 before the 2026-08-21 pre-release, ST31-36 before 2026-07-31), and any event after 2026-10-12 containing the banned OP14-020 leader. metaShare = percent of all 2089 categorized decklists in those events; metaSharePostBan = same over the 7 post-ban/ban-adopting events (342 decklists). In-person Regionals/Finals in the window are not in the count (no complete standings source available); see meta-landscape.md.
tierNote: tier (onepiece.gg) is null for every archetype: onepiece.gg robots.txt disallows anthropic-ai and Claude-Web, so its pages were not opened. tierOpmetagame is from https://opmetagame.com/tier-list/ (OP-17 meta, October 2026), mapped by leader name and color.
